items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: I was supposed to do something for Azika... They told me I’m their next project.

ctx.x: What’s the process of finding your next record, your next CD?

Well I was supposed to do something for Azika and the week I was supposed to go in the studio the distributor went bankrupt and so I mean I had my gigs all subbed out, I had everything ready to go. And that came up and postponed everything. So at this point I have tunes, I have arrangements ready, and it’s just a matter of getting it financially put together. So I don’t know if Azika at this point is getting ready to do something. They told me I’m their next project. And I know they have a new distributor but it…
Well best of luck to you, and I’ll kind of look for you in New York in the future too.
